pass_1_implement_and_verify.scope: Pre-register, implement six operators, build the sidecar, run 2 of the 3 pre-registered experiments, build and validate a candidate GeoTIFF
checks: `pytest tests/test_h80_fhj.py` 8 passed (junction vs planar step, relay tips, exact Aitchison moisture invariance, N≈0 vs dipole exponent, forbidden label column, real-data sidecar range)

Every one of 97 columns canaried in every cell of both executed experiments (16 cells, 1,552 single-feature evaluations); all ≤ 0.90 (worst E_dist 0.8206 on the standard instrument, B_slope_grad 0.6419 on the checkerboard; H80-only max 0.5829)
Format: exact-file validator + independent rasterio audit on the staged bytes — 0 NaN in 12,279,160 cells, 0 positives on the masked catalogue
Lane: pre-placement surface audit + per-raster final-dot audit
Final-dot lane audit stopped the build: 81.17% own-lineage overlap, 72.20% after the H80 physics gate (limit 70%) -> nothing published

findings: The calibrated pi-model under-predicts catalogue-hygienic emissions (B2: 0.0376 vs 0.2778). Detected by running the estimator on B2 before using it; the estimate band therefore uses geometry-matched owner-reported anchors and the model value is reported as a scoped diagnostic only.

The literal 70% rule is geometrically unachievable against `r13-lattice-s5` at 37,654 dots (82.70% floor). Attempting to satisfy it by stuffing dots into the uncovered footprint fringe would be lane evasion, so the boundary fringe was explicitly not used and the failure is reported.
`run_h79_experiments.py`'s 93-column union does not include H80; a 97-column union was added in the H80 runner rather than mutating the shared harness, so the H79 evidence stays reproducible.

pass_3_reread_brief.scope: Re-read the owner brief line by line
findings: Executive summary with a per-site table (file / estimated score / uniqueness) → docs/h80-executive-brief.html §6.
An obvious download and an obvious submit verdict → brief hero, four status tiles, §1 and §7.
No manual step left to a human: every gate is computed and stored as JSON; the brief is generated from it.
Every number is labelled EMPIRICAL ESTIMATE / HOLDOUT-DTI / OWNER-REPORTED; no projection is written as a score.
Negative and unresolved results are kept as deliverables (lane duplicate, G1 failure, model-scope failure, Experiment 2 not run).

The owner asked for an obvious download and verdict: with novelty failing, the brief states plainly that no new file is eligible and points at the best existing file rather than dressing up a duplicate.

residual_limitations: No organizer receipt for any score; 0.2778 / 0.3195 / 0.4413 remain owner-reported.
The holdout withholds catalogue faults, not the hidden test faults; proxy–live rank correlation +0.33 (n.s.).
Two pre-registered hypotheses (drainage-routing with the full 1-m DEM mosaic, InSAR × 3-D MT) need external hosts that this sandbox cannot reach and were not run.
Only GEMSDOE25 is changed; the eight sibling sites are not redeployed.
